functional_assessment.upper_nanoscale_features: Several protrusions and diagonal step remain independently visible in both directions.
functional_assessment.task_relevant_limitation: Distributed long horizontal changes and background offsets, especially lower half, impair broad-area background/height stability beyond one isolated particle tail. Some horizontal boundaries could be real sample morphology; persistence and F/B alone do not identify mechanism.
functional_assessment.current_fullframe_usable_status: not_yet_verified; same-settings independent full confirmation chosen by root is appropriate diagnostic

old200_and_blueguide.prior201_relationship: Same nominal scan settings but intervening manual Withdraw/+Z5–6 presses, AA/fine recovery, time and possible lateral shift. Not a matched causal repair pair.
old200_and_blueguide.spatial_correspondence: Terrace/object layouts differ; no verified single shared translation identifying multiple objects has been established. Old blue-box nominal coordinates are not a current target.

alternative_explanations: Real terrace edges and heterogeneous local particles contribute to morphology and can provoke direction-dependent feedback response.
Transient effective junction/apex changes or object-associated feedback lag can create long row offsets; current and Z alone do not identify the atomistic mechanism.
Residual creep/drift after coarse approach and fine engagement can change apparent location/background slope; it does not by itself explain every abrupt one-row change.
Electronic/feedback disturbances remain possible; no direct independent noise-source measurement here.
conclusions: 201 contains genuine task-relevant long-row/background irregularities while retaining upper-field nanoscale object visibility. It is not appropriate to collapse these observations into either all-tip-bad or verified-clean.

The native scan has current transients without measured4nA events or the known software-floor value in the reviewed core. Later rest lacks>=400pA events, but contains measurable current fluctuations and residual Z drift.

The no-conditioning complete repeat can test reproducibility of localized structures versus shifting row offsets. Do not select an induction point from the historical blue JPEG or count a repair cycle from201.
Candidate upper references are development annotations only; exact usability/background suitability and reference independence must be checked in the repeat before freezing.
processing_and_criteria: No new pass threshold. Existing manual row flags retained. Image/function is primary; spikes are contextual native evidence. New native windows and candidate regions are explicit diagnostic descriptors, not retroactive safety limits.

_portable_export.path_basis: Rewritten included paths resolve relative to this JSON; local-archive IDs resolve in omitted-evidence.json. Embedded scientific source hashes still refer to the original local bytes, not transformed exports.
